name: flat-pack-bench
description:
FLAT-PACK-BENCH: The Benchmark Dataset
	

The full text of questions and images that have been used for prompts are provided in this dataset, structured along with useful metadata.
The directory structure is <question-type>/data/<furniture-category>/<furniture-name>/<video-id>/
Within each such directory is a questions.jsonl file that contains on every line a separate question that refers by file name to images that are provided in prompt_images.
The videos are provided by the base… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/justachetan/flat-pack-bench.
reputation: A niche, task-specific benchmark for vision+language prompts around flat-pack furniture with limited but focused adoption.
